messages.text: Hi — I am Relix for Sanctum. Ask me anything about brand, content, or Instagram drafts for this quiet-luxury lifestyle project.
give me a free connector link for linkedin

Free LinkedIn connector: **Zernio** (same free connector Relix already uses for Sanctum Instagram + WhatsApp).

**Easiest in Relix (recommended)**
1. Open Relix → **Settings → Channels**
2. Paste your LinkedIn URL, e.g. `https://www.linkedin.com/company/<your-company>/` or `https://www.linkedin.com/in/<you>/`
3. Flip the LinkedIn toggle on — Relix will find Zernio, connect it, and send a notification saying connected or connection failed.

**Or connect in Zernio directly**
1. Open https://zernio.com/dashboard
2. Connections → New Connection → **LinkedIn**
3. Finish LinkedIn OAuth (personal profile or company page)
4. Back in Relix Channels, paste the same LinkedIn URL and toggle on so the row shows Connected

Docs: https://docs.zernio.com/guides/connecting-accounts

Note: Instagram (@switchonenergy03) and WhatsApp are already on Zernio. After LinkedIn connects, Relix will list it on Channels with the URL automatically.
give me the connector to add
Here's the connector for LinkedIn. Tap Add, paste your LinkedIn profile or company page URL, and I'll connect it through Zernio. It will show on Channels once it's linked.
